description: A project's RESOURCES for its calendar: rooms and units of equipment — each unit its own row (four lights of one model are four). Each has 'kind' (room, equipment), 'status' (available, repair — a resource under repair is not given to an event), 'x'/'y' (where it stands on the plan, millimetres), 'bufferBefore'/'bufferAfter' (minutes for setting up and clearing, counted as busy) and 'externalId'. Any member may read.
name: list_resources
title: List resources
